title: report
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, DependentModelReportId, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, parentreportid.

applicationid.description: Represents the application id to which a CDS powerbi report belongs to.

bodytext.description: Text contents of the RDL file for a Reporting Services report.

cdsdatasetid.description: Represents the dataset id of a report.

createdinmajorversion.description: Major version number of Crm, used to identify the version of Crm in which report is created.

createdon.description: Date and time when the report was created.

customreportxml.description: XML used to define a custom report.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the report is introduced.

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

iscustomreport.description: Information about whether the report is a custom report.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

ispersonal.description: Information about whether the report is personal or is available to all users.

isscheduledreport.description: Information about whether the report is a scheduled report.

languagecode.description: Language in which the report will be displayed.

managedtype.description: Determine how the report workspace is managed.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the report was last modified.

originalbodytext.description: Original Text contents of the RDL file for a Reporting Services report.

powerbidatasetid.description: Represents the Power BI dataset id of a report.

powerbifeaturetag.description: Field to maintain the sub application id and feature tag for powerbi reports.

powerbireportid.description: Represents the powerbi report id for a CDS report.

powerbireportinternalstate.description: Field to maintain the internal state of the report

powerbireportname.description: Contains the name of the Power Bi embedded report.

powerbiworkspaceinfo.description: Contains the workspace information of the Power Bi embedded report.

rdlhash.description: Hash value of the body text of the report.

reportnameonsrs.description: Name of the report on SRS.

reportstatus.description: Represents the status of the Report.

reportversion.description: Represents the version of a report.

schedulexml.description: XML used for defining the report schedule.

signaturedate.description: Report signature date, used to identify a report for upgrades and hotfixes.

signatureid.description: Unique identifier of the report signature used to identify a report for upgrades and hotfixes.

signaturelcid.description: Report signature language code used to identify a report for upgrades and hotfixes.

signaturemajorversion.description: Report signature major version, used to identify a report for upgrades and hotfixes.

signatureminorversion.description: Report signature minor version, used to identify a report for upgrades and hotfixes.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the report.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the report.

_dependentmodelreportid_value.description: Field to represent the dependent report dataset model.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the report.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the report.

_ownerid_value.description: Unique identifier of the user or team who owns the report.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the report.

_parentreportid_value.description: Unique identifier of the parent report.
